text: Last year, I decided to learn how to manage my money better. First, I made a budget to plan how much I could spend each month. I opened a new account at the bank so I could save some money every week. Before that, I used to spend too much cash on things I didn't really need, and I never had enough at the end of the month. I also had a small debt because I borrowed money from a friend to buy a new phone. It took a few months, but I paid it back completely. Now, when I go shopping, I check the price of things carefully and try to buy cheap products instead of expensive ones. I still use my credit card sometimes, but I try not to lend or borrow money anymore. At the shop, the cashier always gives me my change, and I put the coins in a small jar at home. I also pay my bills on time so I don't have to worry about them later. Learning to save money wasn't easy, but now I feel much more confident about my finances.
